title: P300 dataset BI2012 from a "Brain Invaders" experiment
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalographic (EEG) recordings from 25 healthy subjects performing a visual P300 brain-computer interface task inspired by the Space Invaders video game. Participants viewed sequences of flashing alien groups and silently counted target stimuli while 16-channel EEG was recorded at 128 Hz. The dataset includes both training and online sessions with performance-dependent feedback, providing a benchmark resource for P300-based BCI research and algorithm development.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 16 electrodes (F7, F3, F4, F8, T7, C3, Cz, C4, T8, P7, P3, Pz, P4, P8, O1, O2) using a NeXus-32 amplifier (MindMedia/TMSi) at 128 Hz sampling rate with hardware common average reference and FZ ground. The visual P300 paradigm presented 36 aliens in 12 groups of 6, with 12 flashes per repetition (2 target, 10 non-target). Participants completed a training session (8 repetitions, 128 target and 640 non-target trials) and an online session with three difficulty levels. Stimulus presentation was synchronous with visual feedback through the game interface.
